query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT clienteId) as total_clientes,
  COUNT(*) as total_registros,
  mes,
  ano
FROM cashbarberAtendimentos
WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026
GROUP BY empresaSlug, mes, ano
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
